items.html: And the reason for the matter is that the hairs are hooks (Vavim), because their root is drawn through their passing through the membrane (Kruma), which is of the Tifferet of Atik, as above; therefore they bestow upon Zeir Anpin. But the whitenesses are from Netzah and Hod themselves, which are the eyes and the ears, in a place where there are no hairs. Therefore the righteous, who are from Yesod, suckle from the whitenesses of Netzah and Hod that are above Yesod. Understand this.
